overview: The MPS Building & Grounds Subcommittee received facilities and capital updates for the vocational and high school campuses. The committee voted to approve several facility repairs, including the high school hot water system, generator replacement, transformer repairs, and boiler maintenance.

items.title: Vocational Technical High School Projects Update
items.summary: Vocational Technical High School Director Chad Fallon and instructor Rich Cormio presented updates on student-led shop updates, landscaping improvements, and electrical program expansion.

items.title: Medford High School Main Entrance Signage Proposals
items.summary: The subcommittee voted to gather student polling feedback and refine cost estimates for proposed high school entrance signs before returning to the full committee on June 14.

items.title: Front Entrance Landscaping and Tree Planting Update
items.summary: Staff reported on completed front entrance driveway beautification, fence repairs, and recent campus tree plantings.

items.title: Medford High School Restrooms RFP Status
items.summary: Administration reported that an RFP for high school bathroom renovations is anticipated to issue before the end of the fiscal year for summer construction.

items.title: Solar Speed Signs Installation
items.summary: Buildings and Grounds Director John McLaughlin updated the committee on the placement of 10 mph solar speed signs near the high school and Andrews Middle School.

items.title: Medford High School Hot Water System Replacement
items.summary: The subcommittee voted to approve replacing the failed domestic hot water system serving the high school kitchen, gym, and pool areas.

items.title: Curtis Tufts High School Boiler Repair
items.summary: The subcommittee voted to approve labor costs for sectional repairs to the Curtis Tufts High School boiler using parts acquired over the winter.

items.title: Medford High School Pool Roof Update
items.summary: Staff provided an informational update on a temporary repair to the high school pool roof and a $625,000 estimate received for full replacement.

items.title: Medford High School Emergency Generator Replacement
items.summary: The subcommittee voted to proceed with replacing the non-operational emergency generator at Medford High School.

items.title: Medford High School Transformer Repair
items.summary: The subcommittee voted to approve repairing an oil leak on the high school electrical transformer, estimated at $19,027.
